blockers.statement: The current daemon and gem5 bridge still do not advertise generic capability bit 8 or route message types 18/19/20; CP-0023 proves separate client and local native admission boundaries, not a production session handler.
The retained Triton descriptor carries 12 DWORD (48-byte) kernarg preload and preload-aware native mapping plus entry-offset semantics remain unimplemented; the image must continue to fail closed.
No normal Triton launcher, real daemon transport, GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit kernel execution, output differential, or Qwen inference has been demonstrated through the CP-0023 path.

changes: Accepted matching payload-v2 generic-dispatch codecs in gem5 and self-amdgpu-runtime while preserving the v1 envelope and existing records; runtime word 0 bit 8 maps explicitly to wire byte 1 mask 0x01 and requires all dependency capabilities.

Added append-only runtime MAP, ALLOC_KERNARG, publish, SUBMIT, WAIT, and UNMAP client APIs with owner/epoch/generation-bound opaque handles, strict mapped-VA and kernarg-range checks, canonical failed completions, and v1 compatibility.

Added a separate local gem5 native-state adapter that binds committed image metadata, owner-scoped mappings and allocations, packet-visible kernarg publication, queue fetch and CP submission admission, retirement, unmap, pin lifetimes, and cancelFetch rollback.
Accepted runtime CTest 18/18, gem5 protocol 47/47 plus 47/47 ASAN/UBSAN, and a no-ISA standalone native-state selftest whose wire ACK and identity/cancellation guards pass with execution flags false.

Kept generic capability advertisement, a daemon MessageType 18 route, the retained 12-DWORD Triton preload, normal launcher, GPUDispatcher/ComputeUnit execution, output correctness, and CPU/NVIDIA fallback unclaimed.
limitations: CP-0023 joins a public runtime client contract, strict wire codecs, and a separate local native-state adapter. The runtime test uses an in-process mock transport, and the current daemon/gem5 bridge neither advertises bit 8 nor routes MessageType 18/19/20.

The native selftest proves owner-bound map, allocation, kernarg publication, queue fetch, CP admission, retirement, unmap, pinning, and cancellation bookkeeping only; GPUDispatcher, ComputeUnit, kernel execution, and execution_claim remain false.
Framing remains v1 major/minor 1.0 and existing v1 records remain unchanged. Payload v2.0 is opt-in, runtime word 0 bit 8 maps to wire byte 1 mask 0x01, and all dependency capabilities are mandatory.

The exact Triton target and descriptor metadata remain hash-bound from CP-0021. Its 12-DWORD (48-byte) preload is explicitly NOT_SUPPORTED; no preload-aware native mapping or +256-byte entry semantics are claimed.
Normal Triton launcher/compiler/JIT transport, Triton E2E, Qwen execution, output differential, timing/performance, and CPU/NVIDIA fallback remain 0/1 or false.

The CP23 prepare journal contains a retained same-parent/same-tree, Evidence-Manifest-SHA256-only child identity migration with its script and pre-migration backup; this is audited checkpoint evidence, not a claim that transaction.py provides a native repair operation.

argv: Route negotiated generic payload-v2 records through one owner-bound daemon session handler, advertise capability bit 8 only with complete dependencies, and retain fail-closed preload behavior without CPU or NVIDIA fallback
next_action.expected: CP-0024 must connect the accepted runtime client to one real daemon session handler for MessageType 18/19/20, bind that session to the owner-bound native adapter, and advertise generic capability bit 8 only when all dependencies and lifecycle routes are live. Stale ownership and the retained unsupported preload must fail closed; launcher or GPU execution is a separate later claim.
prerequisites: CP-0023 root checkpoint and EV-0054/EV-0055 are accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.

Gem5 child 67bf805d8c01fe9848b0c9fb5c663d5fbfe2a055/tree b63d1ede7cfdc9149ec40a7285052de53482eab6 and runtime child b043a7ec00499e63ba6ba342711ef22471d9fd09/tree 536394f47ed94ecb5c1f7a49ab188adc94fcabf7 are clean and trailer-bound to EV-0054.
The v1 envelope and records, no-fallback policy, CP20 locked functional fixture, CP21 Triton identities, and CP23 word-to-wire capability mapping remain immutable.
The daemon must leave bit 8 unadvertised until one negotiated session can route MAP, ALLOC_KERNARG, SUBMIT_AQL, completion, and UNMAP end to end; the 12-DWORD preload remains fail-closed.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0023 codec/client/native-admission tests and evidence, both clean child commits, v1 byte compatibility, CP20 B2 execution, CP21 metadata provenance, capability bit 8 unadvertised, and Triton E2E=0/1 if daemon routing cannot be completed safely.
